note: Relative effects applied to the user's own 10-year baseline risk on the heart page. Primary prevention only (no prior heart attack or stroke). Each action records what its numbers were checked against.

statin.source: USPSTF evidence review, Chou et al., JAMA 2022;328(8):754-771 (22 trials, adults without prior CVD, 6 months to 6 years)
statin.verified_against: JAMA abstract and USPSTF evidence summary

bp.source: Blood Pressure Lowering Treatment Trialists' Collaboration, Lancet 2021;397:1625-36 (48 trials, 344,716 people; median 4.15 years)

event.label: major cardiovascular events, people without prior CVD, per 5 mmHg

aspirin.source: USPSTF evidence review, Guirguis-Blake et al., JAMA 2022;327(16):1585-1597 (11 trials, 134,470 adults 40+ without CVD)
aspirin.verified_against: JAMA abstract and AHRQ evidence update (odds ratios, used as relative risks)

checkups.source: Cochrane review, Krogsbøll et al., general health checks in adults, 2019 (CD009009)
